# Main Figures

## Fig. 1
```{r}
# Import outlines: First list jpeg files to import
jpg.list <- list.files("outlines", pattern=c( ".jpg"), full.names=TRUE) 

# import them
spores <- Momocs::import_jpg(jpg.paths = jpg.list, auto.notcentered = T)

# do momocs analysis
out_spores <- Momocs::Out(spores)
out_spores <- Momocs::coo_center(out_spores)
out_spores <- Momocs::coo_align(out_spores)
out_spores_scaled <- Momocs::coo_scale(out_spores)
out_spores_smoothed <- Momocs::coo_smooth(out_spores_scaled, n = 5)
efourier_spores <- Momocs::efourier(out_spores_scaled, nb.h = 10, norm = TRUE)
pca_spores <- Momocs::PCA(efourier_spores)
plot(pca_spores, main = "PCA of Amanita Spore Shapes (Fourier Analysis)")

```

# clean pca data and prep for data merge
```{r}
# Extract PCA scores and add species names if available
pca_scores_df_species <- as.data.frame(pca_spores$x)  # PCA scores
pca_scores_df_species$species <- rownames(pca_scores_df_species) # Add species as a column if not already
head(pca_scores_df_species)

write.csv(pca_scores_df_species, file = "PCA_Spore_Scores_Species_original.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```


```{r}
# Standardize species names and store them in a new column 'species_clean'
pca_scores_df_species <- pca_scores_df_species %>%
  mutate(species_clean = str_replace(species, "Amanita_", "A_"),     # Replace 'Amanita_' with 'A_'
         species_clean = str_extract(species_clean, "^A_[a-z]+"))    # Keep only 'A_speciesname'

# Check the updated dataframe
head(pca_scores_df_species)
# Check results
unique(pca_scores_df_species$species_clean)
write.csv(pca_scores_df_species, file = "PCA_Spore_Scores_Species.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

# calculate variance

```{r}
# Calculate the proportion of variance explained
variance_explained <- (pca_spores$sdev^2) / sum(pca_spores$sdev^2) * 100

# Create a data frame for plotting
variance_df <- data.frame(
  PC = factor(paste0("PC", 1:length(variance_explained)), levels = paste0("PC", 1:length(variance_explained))),
  Variance = variance_explained
)
```


# ADD THE NICHE TO PCA CHARTS 

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)

# Load the niche data (corrected path based on new upload)
niche_data <- read.csv("spreadsheets/Spores_Amanita_ecological_niche.csv")

# Check results
unique(niche_data$species)
```

```{r}

# Check the column names to ensure the correct merge key
colnames(niche_data)
colnames(pca_scores_df_species)

# Add a new 'Ecology' column from niche_data to pca_scores_df_species
pca_merged <- pca_scores_df_species %>%
  mutate(Ecology = niche_data$Ecology[match(species_clean, niche_data$species)])

```

```{r}
# Check the merged dataframe
head(pca_merged)

write.csv(pca_merged, file = "PCA_Spore_Scores_Species_and_niche.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Find out a list of all the species i have morphological data about
# BUT no ecological data

```{r}

# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)

# Load the PCA data with species and niche information
pca_data <- read.csv("PCA_Spore_Scores_Species_and_niche.csv")

# Extract species without ecological niche data
species_missing_niche <- pca_data %>%
  filter(is.na(Ecology) | Ecology == "") %>%  # Filter rows with missing or empty Ecology
  distinct(species)                           # Get distinct species names

# View the list
print(species_missing_niche)

# Optional: Save to a CSV file
write.csv(species_missing_niche, "species_missing_niche.csv", row.names = FALSE)



```

# Run analysis with merged data

```{r}

# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)

# Convert Ecology codes (1/2) to descriptive labels and filter missing data
pca_data_filtered <- pca_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Ecology) & Ecology != "") %>%       # Remove missing Ecology data
  mutate(Ecology = factor(Ecology, 
                          levels = c(1, 2), 
                          labels = c("Ectomycorrhizal (EM)", "Saprotrophic (SAP)")),
         data_point_id = row_number())              # Assign unique ID for plotting


head(pca_data_filtered)
write.csv(pca_data_filtered, "pca_and_niche_data_only.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}


# Define colors for the ecological niches
niche_colors <- c("Ectomycorrhizal (EM)" = "green", 
                  "Saprotrophic (SAP)" = "orange")

# Create the stacked histogram
ggplot(pca_data_filtered, aes(x = PC1, fill = Ecology)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, position = "stack", color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = niche_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of PC1 Scores Colored by Ecological Niche",
    x = "PC1 Score (Binned)",
    y = "Number of Data Points",
    fill = "Ecological Niche"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )
  ggsave("PC1_niche_bar_chart.png", width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)



```

# Box and whisker plot and analysis

```{r}

# Box and whisker plot
ggplot(pca_data_filtered, aes(x = Ecology, y = PC1, fill = Ecology)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.color = "red", outlier.shape = 8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Ectomycorrhizal (EM)" = "green", "Saprotrophic (SAP)" = "orange")) +
  labs(
    title = "Boxplot of PC1 Scores by Ecological Niche",
    x = "Ecological Niche",
    y = "PC1 Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )
  ggsave("PC1_niche_box_whisker.png", width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)


```

# significance testing

```{r}
# t-test for PC1 scores between the two ecological niches
t_test_result <- t.test(PC1 ~ Ecology, data = pca_data_filtered)
print(t_test_result)

# Wilcoxon test if data does not meet t-test assumptions
wilcox_result <- wilcox.test(PC1 ~ Ecology, data = pca_data_filtered)
print(wilcox_result)

# Shapiro-Wilk test for normality
shapiro_test_EM <- shapiro.test(pca_data_filtered$PC1[pca_data_filtered$Ecology == "Ectomycorrhizal (EM)"])
shapiro_test_SAP <- shapiro.test(pca_data_filtered$PC1[pca_data_filtered$Ecology == "Saprotrophic (SAP)"])

print(shapiro_test_EM)
print(shapiro_test_SAP)

```


```{r}


# Install if necessary: install.packages("ggpubr")
library(ggpubr)

ggboxplot(pca_data_filtered, x = "Ecology", y = "PC1",
          color = "Ecology", palette = c("green", "orange"),
          add = "jitter") +
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", label.y = max(pca_data_filtered$PC1) + 0.1) + # Shows p-value
  labs(
    title = "Boxplot of PC1 Scores by Ecological Niche with p-value",
    x = "Ecological Niche",
    y = "PC1 Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )
  ggsave("PC1_niche_box_whisker_with_p_value.png", width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)


```
